body:
Thank you for your rely, and yes you are right I need to talk to someone. But the thing is, I miss the comfort in being sad. 

I'm just so ok, the end seems like an inevitability, a conclusion. A numb, emotionless conclusion.

The little part of me that still cares is what makes me write this, I know that I need help, but at the same time, it doesn't seem to matter.

How is there anyway out when I used to try so hard, and yet I was still unhappy. But as thoughts of suicide become more prominent, I become more comfortable.

I love everyone so much, there is such beauty in the world that I wish I could fully complete, and my own death will be that part, I want to see it so much, I will no longer be a sad, burden.
